title: My niece sang a lullaby nobody taught her 🎵
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 3:40 in the morning my little niece sang a lullaby nobody taught her.

scenes.narration: At 3:40 in the morning my little niece sang a lullaby nobody taught her.
She was asleep on the camp bed in my spare room. Her eyes were closed. The tune was slow, in a language I could not place, and she had never heard it.
I felt I knew it. Like a smell from a house I left a long time ago, and was never allowed to go back to.
I opened an old video on my phone. The only one I have of my gran. She was humming. The same notes. The same slow tune.
My niece stopped singing. Her eyes stayed shut. In a flat little voice she said, she wants her song back.
The window rattled. The room turned cold. And on the wall, my shadow stood up, though I was still sitting.
My niece rolled over and whispered, now you sing it, and tell everyone you taught it to me. Behind me, my shadow was already humming.
So tell me. Do you sing it, or stay silent?
